## About Me

I am a Wesleyan University senior investigating how data and communication, as interwoven practices, influence public life. My work focuses on crafting experiments and designing narratives that make evidence accessible and encourage civic engagement. 

- **Data & Research:** Conducting surveys and assessing behavioral data to test hypotheses and inform strategy
- **Communication & Writing:** Transforming complex research and realities into engaging narratives for public and professional audiences. 
- **Versatile Application:** Navigating interdisciplinary contexts to provide clear insights: from courses, to corporations, to clients.
